product_one_liner.value: Maximum provides banks with an AI-native operating system that supports custom AI agents to automate workflows, provide real-time visibility into customer activity, and deliver financial products.
product_one_liner.notes: Maximum’s homepage describes its AI-native banking operating system, its intended bank users, and custom agents that automate workflows and enable financial products.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage footer lists Home, Newsroom, Careers, LinkedIn, and legal links, with no pricing link; the site presents a request-access call to action instead of public plans.

named_customers.notes: The public customer announcement names Emprise Bank as a design partner and says initial traffic is expected by the end of 2026; the reviewed customer announcement names no second customer, so the evidence does not meet the requirement to name at least two.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn’s company profile reports 11 employees; that count falls within the requested 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Dealroom identifies Miami as Maximum’s headquarters city. | hq_country: Dealroom identifies Maximum’s headquarters as Miami, United States.

founded_year.notes: PitchBook lists Maximum’s year founded as 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The company’s newsroom index is labeled “In the Press” and lists external news and investor coverage, not engineering-authored technical posts.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer contain no public documentation or help-center link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Ashby board lists three open roles, all titled software engineering roles, with no AI, ML, data-science, or related role title.

compliance_certs.notes: Maximum’s privacy/legal page has a security section describing general safeguards but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Maximum’s press release explicitly calls the August 2026 round a Seed round. | funding_date: The dated Maximum press release is timestamped August 3, 2026, which supplies the round month 2026-08. | funding_amount_usd: Maximum’s August 3, 2026 press release states that it emerged from stealth with a $30 million Seed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $30 million Seed round was announced August 3, 2026, inside the 18-month period ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board enumerates all three open positions and each is an engineering role, with no SDR, BDR, or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 3, 2026, Maximum publicly emerged from stealth and introduced its AI-native bank operating system; this announcement falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live job board lists three engineering roles, and the readable postings name no CRM or sales/marketing system; the homepage also provides no integrations/docs link.
